title: List files installed by a specific package
summary: See exactly which files were installed on your system by a specific software package. Useful for debugging or finding where an app put its files.

steps.explain: Use pkgutil with the --files flag and the package ID to list all files associated with that package.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_ID
placeholders.description: The identifier of the installed package (e.g., com.microsoft.Word)
